Commercial property for sale in Maple Ridge: industrial buildings and strata units, offices, retail space, commercial land and businesses listed on the MLS®. This search shows properties for sale only; spaces for lease are not included. Call or text Jared Gibbons at 604-928-1361 for a property that is not listed, or to value one you own.
Commercial and industrial areas in Maple Ridge

items.t: Maple Ridge has 749 hectares of industrial land in the regional inventory (July 1, 2025). ([Metro Vancouver 2025 Industrial Lands Inventory](https://metrovancouver.org/services/regional-planning/Documents/mv-industrial-lands-inventory-summary-report-appendices-2025.pdf), read November 20, 2026)

The City says it has over 300 hectares of industrial and employment land available. Its main shopping centres, Haney Place Mall and Valley Fair Mall in the town centre and Westridge Centre and Westgate Shopping Centre in west Maple Ridge, are all off Lougheed Highway. ([City of Maple Ridge, industries](https://www.mapleridge.ca/build-do-business/invest-maple-ridge/industries), read November 20, 2026)
All businesses operating in Maple Ridge need a business licence. ([City of Maple Ridge, business licensing](https://www.mapleridge.ca/build-do-business/business-licensing), read November 20, 2026)

blocks.text: In the second quarter of 2026, 10 commercial properties sold in Maple Ridge (against 6 a year earlier), worth $18.0M in all: 4 industrial, 3 land, 0 office, 3 retail and other, and 0 multi-family.
Source: Greater Vancouver REALTORS® Commercial Edge, Q2 2026 (as reported on [the Fraser Valley commercial market report](/fraser-valley-commercial-market-report.html)).

Industrial space in the Maple Ridge / Pitt Meadows submarket (6.5M sq ft) was 7.9% vacant in the third quarter of 2026, asking $18.21 per sq ft net plus $5.20 in additional rent, with 366,865 sq ft under construction. Across Metro Vancouver vacancy was 4.0%.
Source: Avison Young, Metro Vancouver industrial market report, Q3 2026 (as reported on [the Fraser Valley commercial market report](/fraser-valley-commercial-market-report.html)).
